name: work-with-tony
description: Tony's personal toolkit of Claude Code plugins

plugins.name: linkedin-post
plugins.description: Draft LinkedIn posts in conversation and publish them to your personal profile through the official LinkedIn API.

plugins.name: prd-check
plugins.description: Check a Markdown PRD against your team's template and rules, and write a line-numbered report of what to fix.

plugins.name: suno-music
plugins.description: Prepare Suno Advanced song forms from approved lyrics and style without spending credits.

plugins.name: plugin-release
plugins.description: Validate Claude Code and Codex plugins, synchronize local marketplace metadata, and guide a verified Git release.

plugins.name: tony-workmate
plugins.description: Turn requests into actionable handoffs, draft channel-ready messages, preserve document formats, and finish meetings, calendar entries, deliveries, expense claims, and follow-ups.

plugins.name: explain-this
plugins.description: Explain local Markdown, HTML, and JSON files and optionally build a safe offline learning exercise.

plugins.name: instagram-carousel
plugins.description: Plan and build editable editorial Instagram carousels, then export verified 1080x1350 PNG slides locally.

plugins.name: repurpose
plugins.description: Turn one source into a LinkedIn post draft and an Instagram carousel plan that share one confirmed message, then hand each to its channel plugin.

plugins.name: hwp-form
plugins.description: Fill Korean HWP/HWPX application forms from your saved profile and materials into a new HWPX copy, leaving signatures, consent, and gaps on a checklist.
